# ContentFellow

> ContentFellow is a UK creative and digital marketing service. Businesses and creators hire "Fellows" (specialists) on simple monthly plans from £59 a month: production, video editing, social media, websites and SEO & GEO for AI search.

## Plans (brand pricing, monthly; personal plans 15% lower)
- Studio Fellow (£149/mo): one on-site shoot a month up to 3 hours, photo + 4K video, 20 edited photos in 5 working days
- Creator Fellow (£119/mo): 8 short videos for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1 motion graphics video, 1 podcast edit up to 60 min
- Social Fellow (£59/mo Manage: up to 2 platforms, weekday replies, ad set-up; £129/mo Manage + Post: up to 3 platforms, daily posting, trend research)
- Build Fellow (£69/mo): custom website up to 5 pages, hosting, security, updates, 2 change requests a month
- Search Fellow (£89/mo): SEO for Google, GEO so ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend you, monthly ranking + AI visibility report
- Growth Fellow (£389/mo, £555 separately): all five Fellows, a Growth lead, one strategy, one monthly report

- [Build Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/build-fellow/): Build Fellow (£69/mo): website build, hosting, updates
- [Studio Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/studio-fellow/): Studio Fellow (£149/mo): monthly photo + 4K video shoot
- [Creator Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/creator-fellow/): Creator Fellow (£119/mo): Reels, motion graphics, podcast editing
- [Growth Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/growth-fellow/): Growth Fellow (£389/mo): all five Fellows + Growth lead

## Location
- [Burnley & Lancashire](https://contentfellow.com/burnley/): based in Burnley, Lancashire; on-site shoots within ~20 miles (Padiham, Nelson, Colne, Accrington, Clitheroe, Blackburn, Rawtenstall, Todmorden); all other services UK-wide

## Contact
- [Free AI visibility check / get a plan](https://contentfellow.com/get-started/): 2-minute form; free check of who ChatGPT and Gemini recommend in your area, emailed within 2 working days

## Development (one-off, fixed price)
- Websites: Launch £349 (up to 7 pages), Grow £749 (up to 15 pages, blog, booking), Shop £1,499 (up to 100 products)
- Apps: App Starter £1,249 (web app), App Pro £3,499 (iPhone + Android, 10 screens), App Custom from £6,499
- Details: https://contentfellow.com/services/development/
